pt.about_label:
Prazer, me chamo David. Sou tradutor de inglês para português e editor gráfico. Sou apaixonado pelas criações da Valve e fã de suas franquias, em especial Portal, que é o jogo da minha vida. O bolo é uma mentira! Graças a isso, entrei no mundo da tradução, tendo como meu primeiro projeto a tradução das texturas do Half-Life 2. Gosto de trabalhar em projetos diversificados no meu tempo livre. Um deles, que desejo tornar realidade, é meu canal no YouTube. Sou o criador do projeto Source BR e membro da Mesa Preta Dubs.

Visite a aba de projetos para ver minhas criações, detalhes sobre elas e, claro, baixá-las. Caso queira entrar em contato comigo, basta utilizar uma das redes disponíveis. Obrigado por ler até aqui!

;)

en.hero_subtitle: Translator, graphic editor, and Valve enthusiast.
en.warning_label: This project is not yet completed.
en.ez1_description:
This project aims to fully dub and translate the Entropy Zero mod into Brazilian Portuguese. This project uses content from Mesa Preta Dubs

My participation
I am the creator of the project, the voice actor for Bad Cop, responsible for audio mixing, and I helped translate and adapt texts, interface elements, subtitles, and textures.
en.ez2_description:
This project aims to fully dub and translate the Entropy Zero 2 mod into Brazilian Portuguese. This project uses content from Mesa Preta Dubs

My participation
I am the creator of the project, the voice actor for Bad Cop, responsible for audio mixing, and I helped translate and adapt texts, interface elements, subtitles, and textures.

Note
This project will probably never be finished, so don't expect much beyond Combine voice lines.
en.tfc_description:

My participation
I helped translate textures.
en.ricochet_description:
This project aims to fully translate Ricochet into Brazilian Portuguese.

My participation
I helped translate the interface and textures.

Note
Why does this even exist...? Jv must be stopped.
en.dmc_description:
This project aims to fully translate Deathmatch Classic into Brazilian Portuguese.

My participation
I am the creator of the project and helped translate the interface and textures.
en.nd_description:
This project aims to fully translate Narbacular Drop into Brazilian Portuguese.

en.darker_description:
This project aims to bring a dark mode to Hammer++, providing a better experience for users who prefer dark themes.

My participation
I am the creator of the project, creator of the icons adapted for the dark theme, and maintainer of the DLLs adapted for it.
en.voa_description:
This project aims to make it easier to legally download Valve games on Android.

My participation
I am the original creator of the project. I developed it during a time when I had no access to my PC and wanted a simple way to download original Valve games from Steam directly on my phone without needing a computer.

en.about_label:
Nice to meet you, my name is David. I am an English-to-Portuguese translator and graphic editor. I am passionate about Valve's creations and a fan of their franchises, especially Portal, which is my favorite game of all time. The cake is a lie! That's what got me into translation, starting with translating textures for Half-Life 2. I enjoy working on a variety of projects in my free time. One project I hope to turn into reality is my YouTube channel. I am the creator of the Source BR project and a member of Mesa Preta Dubs.

Visit the projects tab to see my creations, learn more about them, and of course, download them. If you'd like to contact me, feel free to reach out through one of the available social links. Thanks for reading this far!

;)
